standardized.notes: RFC 854 obsoletes RFC 764 but earlier ad hoc/NCP-era Telnet history remains a separate genealogy.

operations.diagnostics: Negotiation traces reveal option/echo/NVT interoperability problems.
operations.remote_management: Historically used for remote interactive access; later security history must be tracked separately.
operations.failure_behavior: Terminal option/echo/line-ending disagreements can make a connection operationally unusable despite transport success.
operations.operator_interface: NVT plus Telnet option negotiation; local PTY/terminal mapping is implementation-specific.

open_questions: Recover NCP-era and BSD Telnet source implementations.
Inventory Telnet option RFCs and first deployed implementations.
notes: Telnet is not merely an obsolete shell command; its core artifact is a virtual-terminal interoperability architecture. SSH is not a formal Telnet revision.
